question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Cornucopia
solution:
The correct answer is '**Treasure trove**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** synonym for the given word '**Cornucopia**' is '**Treasure trove**'.
 
• The meaning of the word '**Cornucopia**' is '**an abundant supply of good things of a specified kind**'.
 
• The meaning of the word '**Treasure trove**' is '**treasure that anyone finds, specifically: gold or silver in the form of money, plate, or bullion**'.
 
• Hence, the **most appropriate** answer is '**Treasure trove**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• **Sinkhole**- a large hollow space in the ground into which a river flows, created by rainwater over a very long period of time.
 
• **Malaise**- a general feeling of being slightly ill or unhappy without any particular reason.
 
• **Avarice**- extreme desire for money.
